cover: Strikes kill seven, including a boy
Youth leader stopped from flying to UK

stories.label: Palestine
stories.figlab: killed in a day, medics say
stories.place: Wadi Gaza, al-Mawasi and Gaza City
stories.head: Strikes kill a boy and three police
bullets: A Hamas security chief was killed in Gaza City.
Meningitis cases hit 272 in October, eight times usual.
Israel's military said it struck 'military operatives'.

stories.label: DR Congo
stories.figlab: killed near Bunia, 3 of them civilians
stories.head: Ebola responders trapped by fighting
bullets: WHO staff sheltered in a hospital maternity ward.
Residents fled towards Bunia; shops and markets shut.
The CRP armed group said on 24 Nov it was withdrawing.
stories.src: UN News · Radio Okapi · Al Jazeera

stories.label: India · Movement
stories.figlab: days to answer a passport notice
stories.head: Youth leader stopped from flying to UK
bullets: Saurav Das was invited to speak at Oxford and LSE.
He says he saw the notice only at immigration.
An official cited mismatched birth details; Das denies any.

stories.label: India · Religion
stories.head: Family church razed after complaint
bullets: The Christian family had reported vandalism on 21 Nov.
It was demolished the next day with officials present.
Officials say it was on government land; family says forced.
